en.headline: Police and Immigration arrest 22 in New Territories South operation
en.dek: The joint anti-illegal worker and anti-vice action on Wednesday used small drones for high-altitude patrols and targeted blackspots across several districts.
body: Police and the Immigration Department arrested 22 people during a joint operation against illegal workers and vice activities across the New Territories South on Wednesday.

The operation, codenamed CHAMPION and POWERPLAYER, involved the regional tactical unit, the drone team and officers from the Kwai Tsing, Tsuen Wan, Sha Tin, Lantau and Airport police districts. Small drones were used alongside ground teams for high-altitude anti-crime patrols.

Those arrested included one local man, one local woman, one non-Chinese man, one non-Chinese woman, seven mainland men and 11 mainland women, aged between 27 and 51. They were held on suspicion of offences including using forged documents, employing people not lawfully employable, breaching conditions of stay, and being wanted persons.
Two mainland women and one non-Chinese woman were also arrested in Tsuen Wan on suspicion of prostitution and breaching conditions of stay. All are being detained for investigation.

zh.headline: 新界南跨部門打擊黑工掃黃 拘捕22人
zh.dek: 周三行動代號「冠軍」及「權能者」，使用小型無人機配合地面人員高空巡邏，突擊多個罪案黑點。
body: 警方及入境事務處周三在新界南多區展開聯合行動，打擊非法勞工及賣淫活動，共拘捕22人。
行動代號「冠軍」及「權能者」，由新界南總區機動部隊、無人機隊，以及葵青、荃灣、沙田、大嶼山及機場警區人員參與。執法人員利用小型無人機配合地面隊伍進行高空巡邏。
被捕人士包括1名本地男子、1名本地女子、1名非華裔男子、1名非華裔女子、7名內地男子及11名內地女子，年齡介乎27至51歲，分別涉嫌行使偽造文件、僱用不可合法受僱的人、違反逗留條件及通缉人士等。
其中兩名內地女子及一名非華裔女子在荃灣區因涉嫌賣淫及違反逗留條件被捕。所有人正被扣留調查。
